_comment: Mock data for the web layer. Shape matches contracts/schema.md exactly. The 'audit' object is the audits/{auditId} document; 'findings' is the audits/{auditId}/findings subcollection flattened into an array. Three findings: one straightforward axe fix, one axe fix that requires a human, one visual finding axe cannot catch.

findings.userImpact: Someone using a screen reader reaches the end of the contact form and hears only 'button', with no way to tell that it sends the message.
findings.changeSummary: Named the submit button and hid its decorative icon.

findings.userImpact: A screen reader announces the filename 'team-photo-final-v2.jpg' instead of describing the team, so the person learns nothing from the image.
findings.changeSummary: Added an alt attribute requiring a human-written description.
findings.humanGuidance: Replace the placeholder with a description of what the photo actually shows and why it is on this page — for example 'The six-person A11ySentinel team standing outside the Antananarivo office'. If the image is purely decorative and adds nothing the surrounding text does not already say, use alt="" instead.

findings.userImpact: The 'most popular' plan is marked only by a green border. Someone who cannot distinguish the colour sees three identical plans and no recommendation.
findings.evidence: The middle pricing card carries a 2px green border and no label, badge, or text distinguishing it from the two cards beside it.
findings.changeSummary: Added a text badge so the recommendation is not colour-only.
